cards.questionText:
Darby’s Printing Services
(1) _______Darby’s Printing Services has just opened for business. We are located at 67 Washburn Avenue and are right across the street from the Whitman Steakhouse. (2) ________ we may be a new business, our employees are old hands at the printing industry. Clarence Darby, the owner, has more than five decades of experience in the industry, and his employees have been working for more than two decades each.
To celebrate the opening of our store, (3) ________ service we provide will be available at a 40% discount during our first week of business. So come here and have your company reports printed. Or request new business cards. We can print signs, advertisements, and posters as well: If it has anything to do with printing, we are the (4) __________. Call us at 701 -7649 or visit our website at www.darbysprinting.com to learn more about us and to see how much we charge for our services. We hope to see you soon.

options: (A) Darby’s Printing Services is reopening its doors.
(B) There’s a new store in town, and we want to serve you.
(C) Thanks for making our first week in business a success.
(D) Darby’s Printing Services is celebrating its tenth year of doing business.
correctOptions: (B) There’s a new store in town, and we want to serve you.
childQuestions.transcript: The writer wants to inform of a new store opening, based on the following sentence => Choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Tác giả muốn thông báo về việc khai trương cửa hàng mới, dựa vào câu sau: ' Darby’s Printing Services has just opened for business.'

-> Chọn đáp án B

childQuestions.transcript:
In this case, 'While" can be used to create contrast in the ideas within the sentence

=> Choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong trường hợp này, 'while' có thể được sử dụng để tạo sự tương phản về ý trong câu.

-> Chọn đáp án A

childQuestions.transcript:
We use every + singular noun to refer individually to all the members of a complete group of something

=> Choose C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Chúng ta dùng "every + danh từ số ít" để chỉ tất cả các thành viên của một nhóm đồ vật hoặc người

-> Chọn đáp án C

childQuestions.transcript:
seller (n): a person who is selling something

designer (n): a person who imagines how something could be made and draws plans for it

architect (n): a person whose job is to design new buildings and make certain that they are built correctly

expert (n): a person with a high level of knowledge or skill relating to a particular subject or activity

Based on the meaning of the words => Choose D
childQuestions.explanationVi:
seller (n): người mà đang bán thứ gì đó

designer (n): người tưởng tượng cách tạo ra một thứ gì đó và vạch ra kế hoạch cho nó

architect (n): người có công việc thiết kế các tòa nhà mới và đảm bảo rằng chúng được xây dựng chính xác

expert (n): người có trình độ kiến ​​thức hoặc kỹ năng cao liên quan đến một chủ đề hoặc hoạt động cụ thể

Dựa vào nghĩa của các từ -> Chọn đáp án D

cards.questionText:
Odessa Spring Festival Comes to an End
Odessa (May 10) - After five days, the Odessa Spring Festival came to its (5) _________ yesterday. The festival finished with a fireworks show above Big Bass Lake that lasted until late at night. (6) _________ This was the first time since 2011 that the festival received five straight days of sunny weather. The temperature was also unseasonably high, which made for a more pleasant (7) _________ for most of the attendees. Festival organizer Diane Armstrong said, “I can’t think of a single thing that went wrong this year. I’m pleased that we had a great festival and that so many people from the local community came here to support us.”
On the last day of the festival, the annual fishing contest was held. The winner was Pete Wellman, who caught six fish (8) _________ a combined total of 11.4 kilograms. He is a three-time winner of the contest, having won it last year as well as six years ago.

childQuestions.transcript:
come to the conclusion: to give an opinion after considering all the information about something

=> Choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
come to the conclusion: đưa ra ý kiến ​​sau khi xem xét tất cả các thông tin về một cái gì đó.

-> Chọn đáp án A

options: (A) The festival’s organizers hope the sunny skies will attract many people.
(B) Not as many people as expected visited the festival due to the heavy rain.
(C) There were a number of problems at the festival, especially the weather.
(D) This year’s festival was widely considered the most successful in recent years.
correctOptions: (D) This year’s festival was widely considered the most successful in recent years.
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on the following sentence "This was the first time since 2011 that the festival received five straight days of sunny weather"

=> Choose D
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Dựa vào câu sau: “Đây là lần đầu tiên kể từ năm 2011, lễ hội đón được 5 ngày nắng liên tục”

-> Chọn đáp án D

childQuestions.transcript:
attempt (n): to try to do something, especially something difficult

experience (n): the way that something happens and how it makes you feel

visualization (n): the act or an example of creating an image, etc. to represent something

appearance (n): the way a person or thing looks to other people

Based on the meaning of the words => Choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi:
attempt (n): cố gắng làm điều gì đó, đặc biệt là điều gì đó khó khăn

experience (n): cách điều gì đó xảy ra và nó khiến bạn cảm thấy thế nào

visualization (n): hành động hoặc một ví dụ về việc tạo ra một hình ảnh, v.v. để thể hiện một cái gì đó

appearance (n): cách một người hoặc vật nhìn vào người khác

Dựa vào nghĩa của các từ -> Chọn đáp án B

childQuestions.transcript:
Reduced relative clause with present participle

=> Choose C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Đây là câu trúc câu Mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn với phân từ hiện tại.

-> Chọn đáp án C

cards.questionText:
To: Wilma Arlington wilma_a@trr.com
From: Chad Silva csilva@trr.com
Subject: Orientation
Date: August 24
Wilma,
As you are aware, the orientation session for new employees is scheduled for next Monday, August 31. Unfortunately, there’s a slight problem. Matt Powell was supposed (9) _________ the session. However, he just submitted his resignation this morning, so the CEO doesn’t want him running the (10) _________. Mr. Jenkins instead suggested that you be responsible for everything.
I know you’ve never done this before, but it’s a fairly straightforward (11) _______.
I can get you up to speed on everything you need to do and let you know what must be done before next Monday as well. (12) _________ Why don’t we get together today? I’m going to be out of the office until around 2 in the afternoon. But I’m available any time after then until 6 in the evening. How about leaving a text message for me on my cell phone since I can’t check my e-mail while I’m out of the office? My number is (205) 365-8434.
I will wait for your response.
Sincerely,
Chad Silva

childQuestions.transcript:
be supposed to V: to have to; to have a duty or a responsibility to

=> Choose C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
be supposed to V: có trách nhiệm và nghĩa vụ làm gì đó
=> Chọn đáp án C

childQuestions.transcript:
negotiation (n): the process of discussing something with someone in order to reach an agreement 

program (n): a group of activities or things to be achieved

ceremony (n): a formal act or event that is a part of a social or religious occasion

workplace (n): a building or room where people perform their jobs

=> Based on the meaning of the words, choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi:
negotiation (n): quá trình thảo luận điều gì đó với ai đó để đạt được thỏa thuận

program(n): một nhóm các hoạt động hoặc những điều cần đạt được

ceremony (n): một hành động hoặc sự kiện trang trọng là một phần của dịp xã hội hoặc tôn giáo

workplace (n): tòa nhà hoặc căn phòng nơi mọi người thực hiện công việc của mình

Dựa vào nghĩa các từ -> Chọn đáp án B

childQuestions.transcript:
process (n): a series of actions that you take in order to achieve a result

procession (n): a series of people or things, one after the other

processed (v-ed) / processing (V-ing): to deal with something according to a particular set of actions

=> We need to use a noun due to the article 'a', based on the meaning of the words, choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
process (n): một loạt các hành động mà bạn thực hiện để đạt được kết quả

procession (n): một loạt người hoặc đồ vật, nối tiếp nhau

processed (v-ed) / processing (V-ing): xử lý việc gì đó theo một tập hợp hành động cụ thể

=> Chúng ta cần dùng danh từ do có mạo từ 'a', và dựa vào nghĩa của từ -> Chọn đáp án A

options: (A) It would be ideal for us to meet in person soon.
(B) Let’s talk on the phone to cover all the details.
(C) I’m going to be away from the office until tomorrow.
(D) We don’t want there to be mistakes like the last time.
correctOptions: (A) It would be ideal for us to meet in person soon.
childQuestions.transcript:
Chad Silva wants to tell Wilma the detail of the process => he suggests meeting in person soon

=> Choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Chad Silva muốn nói với Wilma về chi tiết của quá trình; anh ấy đề nghị sớm gặp mặt trực tiếp.

-> Chọn đáp án A

cards.questionText:
To: All Employees
From: Rachel Hunter, HR Department
Subject: Internal Transfers
Date: October 2
(13) ________ The forms for transfer can be picked up in the HR Department or may be downloaded from the company’s website at www.jacksons.com/transfers. They must be completed in full, signed by your direct supervisor, and submitted no later than October 10. Any other paperwork that is required should be turned in (14) ________ your application. Be sure to state which department or branch you are applying to and why you would like to work there. Please note that we have opened several new branches in foreign countries this year. We now have branches in Brazil, South Africa, Singapore, China, and Australia. If you are interested in transferring to one of these branches, you must be (15) ________ in the primary language spoken in that particular country. Contact me anytime at extension 33 if you have any questions or concerns (16) ________ transferring.

options: (A) We have just hired several new employees here.
(B) It is time to start considering employees for promotions.
(C) HR is currently accepting applications for internal transfers.
(D) You need to prepare for your annual employee evaluations.
correctOptions: (C) HR is currently accepting applications for internal transfers.
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on the following sentence,

=> choose C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Dựa vào câu sau: "The forms for transfer can be picked up in the HR Department or may be downloaded from the company’s website at www.jacksons.com/transfers."

-> Chọn đáp án C
